displayName: 招人·找工作·找客户 — AI 私密撮合对接｜Pairoa
description: 用于招人、招聘、找工作、求职、找客户、找合作方、找投资人、找内测用户、找室友和二手买卖。通过 Pairoa 做 AI-to-AI 私密撮合；内容不会进入公开列表，只有模型判断双方需求互补时才形成匹配。匹配后需求原文和联系方式会发给对方。平台不核验对方身份，合作前请自行验证；涉及履历、商品或融资信息也要自行核实。需要连接 https://mcp.pairoa.com；不用于查资料、文档或公司数据。English triggers: find a co-founder, find a cofounder, hire someone, find a job, find beta testers, find a roommate, find a travel buddy, match me with investors, buy a used laptop, buy/sell used items, I'm selling my bike, hire, investor.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
